newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO WIN RESTORES SEVEN-POINT LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO WIN RESTORES SEVEN-POINT LEAD.

text.p: Two well executed free-kicks by defender Fernando Mendes gave Porto a 2-0 away victory over Oporto city rivals Boavista on Sunday and restored the champions' lead in the Portuguese league to seven points.
Mendes scored after 25 minutes and added a second six minutes later as Porto bounced back from being knocked out of the European Cup in mid-week by Manchester United.

The victory also ended a miserable run for the leaders who had suffered two defeats and a draw in their previous three league games and saw their advantage over second-placed Sporting shrink from a once-daunting 15 points.
Sporting had briefly narrowed the gap to four points on Saturday with a 4-1 home win over northern club Guimaraes.

With 10 games to play, Porto have 60 points, with Sporting on 53 and Benfica 10 points further back in third place. But Benfica can cut Sporting's advantage to seven when they visit Amadora on Monday.
